name: 17965-batchdecode-30ba3bfp8-tp2
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 -- block-FP8 sparse MoE, ~30 GB of safetensors over 4 files, ungated.

load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.

launch:
